moduleContract: ESM with explicit named exports and default data-property object; no dynamic CommonJS require or syncBuiltinESMExports

node:child_process.callablePolicy: Every non-default export is a function that immediately throws ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED on invocation or construction, including during snapshot initialization

supportedStatic: allocUnsafe(finite nonnegative number <=16777216): truncate length; fresh zeroed owned Buffer; no pool
node:buffer.unsupportedPrototypePolicy: Every other own Node Buffer prototype function is explicitly installed as a throwing function; inventory checked against pinned Node at test time
deviations: No deprecated Buffer or SlowBuffer constructor
No slab allocator or uninitialized storage; allocUnsafe guarantees fresh zeroed exact backing at offset 0 and ignores poolSize
No arrays, array-like inputs, DataView, non-Uint8 typed arrays, SharedArrayBuffer or resizable backing stores
No copying slice: Buffer.slice shares storage
Source strings limited to 1048576 UTF-16 code units
Only allocUnsafe truncates finite nonnegative fractional sizes; other fractional sizes/index coercions remain outside the declared overloads
Default object and constants frozen; CJS mutation synchronization unsupported
Detached/shared/resizable ArrayBuffers and views fail ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED; inherited Uint8Array APIs keep engine behavior
allocUnsafe validates the raw requested size before truncation; requests above 16777216 reject even if their truncated length would fit
allocUnsafe uses captured constructors and own data code/module/operation fields for validation; detailed Node error text and pooled backing semantics differ
allocUnsafeSlow remains explicitly deferred; no legacy Buffer constructor or other method support follows
